> Review security impact

1. Identify assets, trust boundaries, OAuth scopes, and external APIs.
2. Check XSS in markdown rendering, OAuth token handling, and CSP headers.
3. Confirm least-privilege permissions and immutable action pins.
4. Add regression coverage or a security test case.
5. Keep vulnerability details private until coordinated disclosure.
